title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1, and the idea that a fridge moves heat rather than making cold is often misunderstood.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red for heat given out and blue for heat taken in; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette that stays distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode, plus text labels on the arrows.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/app.html`, `sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Arrows distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: subcooling and superheat
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Real cycles add a few kelvin of subcooling and superheat; the shipped cycle has none.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: thermostat cycling over a day
body:
## Problem
Session 3 is steady state; a real fridge switches on and off.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5 asks for a time-stepping model with a thermal mass and a thermostat.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the inside temperature swings in a band and the daily energy is reported.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Air stays between 3 and 5 C over 24 hours
- [ ] Daily energy within 15 percent of the steady estimate
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated P-h diagram with live COP
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a cycle on a P-h diagram through a summer day; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Animated P-h loop, energy bars and a COP readout that follow a changing kitchen temperature
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
